note: Regional park about 20 km north of Gull Lake, run by the Antelope Lake Regional Park Authority, beside a man-made swimming pond with a sand beach; 9-hole sand-green golf course, concession and a group tenting area. Some sites have water only. About 21 of its 64 sites are sold online by the night; the park also rents seasonal sites. --Claude
summary: Keep (local). SRP page + Let's Camp: 64 sites with water, some 30 A; Let's Camp sells 20 RV sites (30 A + water, 32-40 ft) and 1 tent site by the night; seasonal camping offered (rates on request). Season May 15 - Sep 15. Entry C$10/day; 30 A C$30. Not waterfront kept (man-made swimming pond under 5 acres; the lake is off the campground). Pin OK. Phone '' -> 306-672-3933. Google 4.4 (23).
flags: LONG-STAY (local): nightly share measured only as far as Let's Camp goes - 21 of 64 sites (20 RV + tent site 55, ~33%) are sold online by the night; the SRP page lists 'Camping Seasonal' and says 'Please contact the park for Monthly and Seasonal rates'; how many of the other 43 are seasonal is not stated. No wording discouraging nightly guests. Google Maps 'Antelope Lake Regional Park' 4.4 (23 reviews), shared with the golf course.
BOOKING: reservations open only from May 15 each year (SRP page and SRPA guide); the '$35 reservation fee' is a refundable deposit (cancellation text), so not written as fees.reservation_fee.

WATERFRONT: 'not waterfront' kept. The water beside the sites is the park's man-made swimming pond (~1 ha, under 5 acres = pond, no value; also the park's own swim beach = day use). The Let's Camp map marks 'To Lake' off-map to the SE; no site row reaches Antelope Lake.
PIN: stored 50.27599,-108.41430 sits at the east end of the swimming pond beside the pond-side site row; site rows run SE of it. Google place 50.27601,-108.41656 (~160 m W). OK, no move.
